info.title: Connect Health FHIR Query API
info.description: Clinical intelligence queries against HealthLake for care manager population analytics

get.summary: Get completed appointments for a given period
get.description: Returns a list of patients who have completed appointments within the specified time period. Use this when the care manager asks about recent visits, completed consultations, or appointment history.

parameters.name: period_days
parameters.description: Number of days to look back. Default is 7 (one week).

get.summary: Get patients who need follow-up care
get.description: Returns patients with booked or pending appointments who are due for follow-up. Use this when the care manager asks about pending visits, patients needing attention, or upcoming appointments.
Returns patients who did not attend scheduled appointments in the given period. Use this when the care manager asks about missed visits, no-shows, or patients who need outreach.

parameters.name: period_days
parameters.description: Number of days to look back. Default is 30.

get.summary: Get diabetic patients with overdue A1C lab tests
get.description: Returns patients with diabetes diagnosis who are overdue for HbA1c blood tests. Use this when the care manager asks about diabetes management, overdue labs, A1C tests, or chronic disease management gaps.

200.description: List of diabetic patients overdue for A1C

get.summary: Get a summary for a specific patient by name
get.description: Returns a detailed summary for a specific patient including demographics, conditions, and recent appointments. Use this when the care manager asks about a specific patient by name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Patient name or partial name to search for (e.g. 'Jordan Rivera', 'Jordan', 'Rivera')
